verdict.rationale: Zulip documents first-party self-hosting on 'a system of your choice' with the same software as Zulip Cloud, plus export/import tools to move freely between Cloud and your own servers. That gives users control over where data lives, and community users confirm running their own instances (e.g., on DigitalOcean). However, residency control comes only through running your own infrastructure; there is no evidence of choosing a storage region within the hosted Zulip Cloud service. Missing for 10: Zulip Cloud region/residency selection, documented data-location commitments for the hosted service, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
